metadata.description: ByteZBridge plugins for Indian SMBs, freelancers, CAs, and SaaS founders. Built in Chennai. Ships GST-compliant tax tooling, invoicing, and accounting workflows directly into Claude.

plugins.name: gst-invoice-generator
plugins.description: Generate GST-compliant Indian tax invoices in Claude. Auto-detects CGST+SGST vs IGST from GSTIN state codes, suggests HSN/SAC codes, converts amounts to Indian-numbering words (Lakh/Crore), and links to gstinvoice.app for full PDF generation, dashboard, and GSTR-1 ledger.
plugins.license: Lite version free; full automation Lifetime ₹9,999 — see https://gstinvoice.app/checkout.html
